## tmh enrollments batch-by-filter

Update many enrollments

### Synopsis

Reminds, resends, cancels, renews, archives or unarchives up to 500 enrollments in one request, chosen by id or by filter. Each enrollment succeeds or fails on its own. Requires the `enrollments:write` scope.

--wait polls the Operation until it is done (up to --wait-timeout) and prints it; if it failed, tmh prints its problem and exits as its HTTP status would, or 7 without one.

Scopes: enrollments:write

```
tmh enrollments batch-by-filter [flags]
```

  -d, --data stringArray                 body field as key=value (dotted keys nest, key[]=v appends, key:=<json> sends JSON), or the whole body as @file, @- for stdin, or a JSON document; repeatable. Flags override -d fields, which override the document
  -h, --help                             help for batch-by-filter
      --operation remind                 What to do to each enrollment: remind, `resendInvite`, `cancel`, `recertify`, `archive` or `unarchive`; one of: remind, resendInvite, cancel, recertify, archive, unarchive (required)
      --select.filter.archived           Archived
      --select.filter.course-id string   Course id
      --select.filter.status string      Status; one of: INVITED, EMAIL_BOUNCED, STARTED, ASSESSMENT_IN_PROGRESS, CERTIFIED, CANCELLED, EXPIRING, EXPIRED, ARCHIVED
      --wait                             wait until the Operation is done and print it; a failed Operation exits as its HTTP status would
      --wait-timeout duration            how long --wait waits before giving up (default 5m0s)
